Title: Register with valid details
Preconditions: User is on the Signup/Login page; email is not registered
Steps: 1. Enter name and a new email under 'New User Signup'; 2. Click Signup; 3. Fill in all required account fields; 4. Click Create Account
Test Data: Name: TestUser01; Email: unique test email; valid address/country/state/city; zip: 8001; mobile: 0821234567
Expected Result: Account is created; 'Account Created' confirmation is shown; user can continue and is logged in with their name displayed in the header

Title: Signup with name and email both empty
Preconditions: User is on the Signup/Login page
Steps: 1. Leave name and email empty; 2. Click Signup
Expected Result: Form is not submitted; a validation prompt indicates the required field must be filled in

Title: Signup with email empty
Preconditions: User is on the Signup/Login page
Steps: 1. Enter a name; 2. Leave email empty; 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Form is not submitted; a validation prompt indicates the email field is required

Title: Signup with invalid email format (missing domain)
Preconditions: User is on the Signup/Login page
Steps: 1. Enter a name; 2. Enter an invalid email; 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Form is not submitted; a validation prompt indicates the email address is invalid

Title: Signup with invalid email format (missing @)
Preconditions: User is on the Signup/Login page
Steps: 1. Enter a name; 2. Enter an invalid email; 3. Click Signup
Expected Result: Form is not submitted; a validation prompt indicates the email address is invalid

Title: Signup with an already registered email
Preconditions: An account already exists for the test email
Steps: 1. Enter a name and the already registered email; 2. Click Signup
Expected Result: An error message states that the email address already exists; user is not taken to the account details page

Title: Create account with password left empty

Title: Zip code with letters

Title: Mobile number with letters

Steps: 1. Enter letters in the mobile number field; 2. Fill all other required fields; 3. Click Create Account

Title: Mobile number with special characters
Preconditions: User is on the Account Information page

Expected Result: Account is not created; a validation message indicates the mobile number is invalid

Title: Script input in name field

Title: Email with leading and trailing spaces

Title: Login with invalid email format
